item.title: Nvidia CEO steps down. And, Sen. Chris Van Hollen to run for majority leader
item.description: Nvidia's chief financial officer has been appointed interim CEO after Jensen Huang stepped down from the role. And, Sen. Chris Van Hollen says he will challenge Chuck Schumer for majority leader.
item.content:encoded:
Nvidia's chief financial officer has been appointed interim CEO after Jensen Huang stepped down from the role. And, Sen. Chris Van Hollen says he will challenge Chuck Schumer for majority leader.

item.title: Hegseth awards medal to soldier who chastised him
item.description:
Pete Hegseth was yelled at by a sentinel for poor decorum at Arlington National Cemetery. Now the Secretary of Defense has
given him a medal.

item.title: These swing voters have low expectations for divided government
item.description: Key voters in North Carolina are pessimistic the blue wave flipping control of Congress will solve their economic woes. Many say President Trump will be the chief obstacle.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: These two voter turnout trends explain what happened across the South in the election
item.description: In six states across the Deep South, a drastic swing to the left this election was driven by high Black voter turnout and compounded by a sharp decline in voting rates across Republican-heavy areas.
item.content:encoded:

item.description: President Trump now says there is no need for an Iran deal, pushing Vice President Vance to instead focus on battling corruption.

item.title: Witnesses describe the D.C. shooting that left 1 dead, 4 injured
item.description: A gunman opened fire at a gym in Washington, D.C.'s Logan Circle Thursday morning. One person has been confirmed killed and four others injured. The gunman is dead, according to police.
